name: @pipeworx/mcp-jsonschema

tools.name: validate_json_schema
tools.description: Validate a JSON value against a JSON Schema (draft-07 subset: type, required, properties, additionalProperties, items, enum, const, min/max, minLength/maxLength, pattern, minItems/maxItems, uniqueItems, format). Returns {valid, errors:[{path,message}]}. Keyless, offline.

data.description: The JSON value to validate (any type).

schema.description: The JSON Schema to validate against.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-jsonschema forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the jsonschema pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
